_comment: Capcode labels for sdr/pager_decoder.py. Keys are either an exact capcode as a string ("1234567") or an inclusive range ("2010000-2019999"). Non-numeric keys such as this one are ignored. The labels below are examples - replace them with the capcodes you identify during an authorised survey (use 'cdeck sdr pager --write' to collect them first).
_usage: sudo cp pager_capcodes.json /opt/cyberdeck-arsenal/data/ && cdeck sdr pager --frequency 153.35
